SPARK.title: Spark
SPARK.description: Loose a compact arcane spark along your aim. It stops at the first enemy or solid surface, releasing a small arcane impact.

ARCANE_STRIKE.title: Arcane Strike
ARCANE_STRIKE.description: Focus arcane energy directly on one visible aimed enemy. A woven link identifies the struck target; terrain blocks targeting.

BLOOD_SPARK.title: Crimson Strike
BLOOD_SPARK.description: Snap a crimson spark onto one visible aimed enemy. Blood droplets mark the impact; this attack does not restore health.

POISON_SPARK.title: Venom Sting
POISON_SPARK.description: Burst an acid bubble on one visible aimed enemy, dealing direct damage and applying Poison I for four seconds.

BLOOD_WAVE.title: Blood Wave
BLOOD_WAVE.description: Send a broad crimson crescent along your aim. Its moving front cuts each visible enemy once and dissipates against solid cover.

POISON_WAVE.title: Poison Wave
POISON_WAVE.description: Roll a low green acid wave forwards. Each enemy crossed by its broad front takes one direct hit and Poison I for four seconds.

FLAME_WAVE.title: Flame Wave
FLAME_WAVE.description: Drive a broad wall of flickering embers forwards. Its advancing front hits each visible enemy once and ignites them for three seconds.

CONFUSE.title: Mind Haze
CONFUSE.description: Disorient one visible enemy with Nausea for five seconds and Blindness for two seconds. Deals no direct damage.

STUN.title: Stun
STUN.description: Bind one visible aimed enemy with arcane sparks. Apply Slowness VI and Weakness II for three seconds, with one direct hit; immune enemies may resist the effects.

CAPTURE.title: Arcane Bind
CAPTURE.description: Wind an arcane cage around one aimed enemy for three seconds at level I. Suppress movement and melee damage while the link holds. Cover, range or displacement of more than four blocks breaks it.

ASTRAL_COMET.title: Astral Comet
ASTRAL_COMET.description: Launch a slow astral comet with a bright core and trailing star motes. It bursts around the first enemy or solid surface reached, damaging visible enemies in the impact area.

FIRE_COMET.title: Fire Comet
FIRE_COMET.description: Hurl a slow ember comet with a burning wake. Its first collision releases an area detonation and ignites enemies hit for three seconds.

ARCANE_REPULSE.title: Arcane Repulse
ARCANE_REPULSE.description: Release an expanding arcane pressure ring from your feet. Enemies touched by the advancing rim take one hit and are pushed away; walls block the hit.

FIREBALL.title: Fireball
FIREBALL.description: Throw a compact fireball with a coiling ember trail. Its first collision releases a small area burst and ignites enemies hit for three seconds.

IGNITE.title: Ignite
IGNITE.description: Kindle one visible aimed enemy directly. Deal the listed impact damage and set it burning for three seconds; ordinary fire immunity still applies.

LAUNCH.title: Launch
LAUNCH.description: Send a rising arcane strike into one visible aimed enemy, adding upward velocity. This lifts the target; it does not grant the enemy fall protection.

LEAP.title: Leap
LEAP.description: Vault forwards and upwards in an arcane wake. This is a movement spell with no direct damage; choose a safe landing.

LIGHTNING.title: Lightning
LIGHTNING.description: Call a vertical lightning strike onto your aim. Enemies near the strike take one hit; the spell leaves terrain intact.

SMITE.title: Smite
SMITE.description: Mark your aim with holy light, then deliver a vertical judgement strike. Visible enemies within its impact radius take the listed damage; allies are protected.

FIRE_TWISTER.title: Cinder Vortex
FIRE_TWISTER.description: Raise a stationary ember funnel at your aim for two seconds. Four half-second pulses can damage visible enemies inside and refresh three seconds of burning.

FLAME_THROWER.title: Flamethrower
FLAME_THROWER.description: Channel a narrow flame stream along your aim for three seconds. Six pulses damage enemies and ignite them for three seconds. Solid cover stops the stream.

FLAME_SHOCK_WAVE.title: Cinder Surge
FLAME_SHOCK_WAVE.description: Send an expanding ember ring across the ground around you. Its advancing rim damages each visible enemy once, pushes them away and ignites them for three seconds.

BLOOD_EXPLODE.title: Crimson Rupture
BLOOD_EXPLODE.description: Detonate a crimson bloom at the aimed enemy or reachable aim point. Its radial blood spray damages visible enemies in the impact area once.

BLOOD_STUN.title: Hemorrhagic Shock
BLOOD_STUN.description: Close a crimson binding around one visible aimed enemy. One hit applies Slowness VI and Weakness II for three seconds; this spell does not drain health.

BLOOD_BLOCK.title: Crimson Ward
BLOOD_BLOCK.description: Deflect incoming hostile projectiles for 4 seconds at level I. Higher spell power extends the duration, up to 8 seconds.

SHADOW_BOLT.title: Shadow Bolt
SHADOW_BOLT.description: Launch a twisting shadow bolt. Its first collision releases a small void impact, applying Weakness I for three seconds to enemies hit.

SOUL_SEEKER.title: Umbral Seeker
SOUL_SEEKER.description: Release a dark wisp that steers toward the enemy selected at release. Its impact damages and weakens enemies; solid cover intercepts the projectile.

DARK_WAVE.title: Umbral Wave
DARK_WAVE.description: Advance a broad curtain of shadow along your aim. Each enemy touched by the moving front takes one hit and Weakness I for three seconds.

NIGHTFALL.title: Nightfall
NIGHTFALL.description: Collapse a cloud of shadow at your aim. Visible enemies in the burst take one hit, Weakness I for three seconds and brief Darkness.

SHADOW_CAGE.title: Dread Mark
SHADOW_CAGE.description: Fasten an orbiting shadow curse to one aimed enemy. After two seconds it bursts around that enemy, damaging and weakening nearby enemies. Losing line of sight or exceeding the link range breaks the curse.

SOUL_AURA.title: Umbral Veil
SOUL_AURA.description: Carry a dark soul aura with you for three seconds. Three one-second pulses damage visible nearby enemies and apply Weakness I for three seconds.

THUNDER_BOLT.title: Thunder Bolt
THUNDER_BOLT.description: Fire a compact electric bolt with a jagged spark wake. The first enemy or solid surface stops it and releases a small electric impact.

CHAIN_LIGHTNING.title: Chain Lightning
CHAIN_LIGHTNING.description: Connect up to five distinct visible enemies with jagged lightning links. Each jump chooses a nearby eligible enemy; cover and the jump radius can end the chain early.

THUNDER_WAVE.title: Thunder Wave
THUNDER_WAVE.description: Send a broad, crackling electric front forwards. Each enemy crossed by its moving rim takes one hit.

STORM_CALL.title: Storm Call
STORM_CALL.description: Establish a lightning storm at your aim for 4.8 seconds. Five one-second pulses damage visible enemies; additional lightning columns show the active storm area.

THUNDER_PULSE.title: Thunder Pulse
THUNDER_PULSE.description: Unleash an expanding electric ring from your feet. The moving rim damages and pushes each visible enemy once, with sparks tracing its current reach.

STATIC_SHOCK.title: Static Shock
STATIC_SHOCK.description: Overload one visible enemy with static. Deal one hit and apply Slowness VI and Weakness II for three seconds.

GRAVITY_BOLT.title: Rift Bolt
GRAVITY_BOLT.description: Send a compressed spatial orb along your aim, trailed by inward-curling portal motes. Its first collision releases a small force impact.

GRAVITY_WELL.title: Rift Well
GRAVITY_WELL.description: Open a stationary gravity well for 4.8 seconds. Pull visible enemies horizontally toward its centre and deal five one-second area pulses; walls block damage and pulling.

FORCE_PUSH.title: Force Push
FORCE_PUSH.description: Strike one visible aimed enemy with an outward spatial impulse. Deal direct damage and launch it away from the caster with a small upward lift.

FORCE_PULL.title: Force Pull
FORCE_PULL.description: Catch one visible aimed enemy with a spatial link. Deal direct damage and pull it horizontally toward you with a small upward lift.

GRAVITY_CHOKE.title: Suspension
GRAVITY_CHOKE.description: Suspend one visible aimed enemy above its starting point for two seconds. Deal one hit, slow it and briefly grant Slow Falling. Cover, range or displacement beyond four blocks breaks the hold.

SINGULARITY.title: Singularity
SINGULARITY.description: Collapse a concentrated spatial orb at your aim. One radial force burst damages and pushes visible enemies; this instant spell leaves no lingering gravity well.

ECHO_BOLT.title: Echo Bolt
ECHO_BOLT.description: Fire a resonant soul bolt with blue sculk motes. It ends at the first enemy or solid surface, releasing a small echo impact.

SCULK_WAVE.title: Sculk Wave
SCULK_WAVE.description: Roll a broad sculk resonance front forwards. Each visible enemy crossed by the advancing wave takes one hit.

SONIC_SCREAM.title: Sonic Scream
SONIC_SCREAM.description: Charge for one second, then unleash a deafening, wide sonic scream over 12 blocks. Cover blocks the blast.

SOUL_SIPHON.title: Soul Siphon
SOUL_SIPHON.description: Damage a visible aimed target and restore 40% of health actually removed, capped at 2 health at level I. Healing scales with spell power.

SOUL_PRISON.title: Soul Prison
SOUL_PRISON.description: Imprison one aimed enemy in a winding soul cage for three seconds at level I. Three one-second hits apply Darkness while the hold suppresses movement. Cover, range or displacement breaks the link.

SHRIEKING_PULSE.title: Shrieking Pulse
SHRIEKING_PULSE.description: Release a radial sculk shriek. An expanding soul ring damages and pushes each visible enemy once as its rim passes them.

AMETHYST_NOVA.title: Amethyst Nova
AMETHYST_NOVA.description: Shatter a resonant amethyst bloom at your aim. Crystal motes radiate from one area burst, damaging and pushing visible enemies in range.

ECHO_WARD.title: Echo Ward
ECHO_WARD.description: Deflect incoming hostile projectiles for 4 seconds at level I. Higher spell power extends the duration, up to 8 seconds.

ARCANE_VOLLEY.title: Arcane Volley
ARCANE_VOLLEY.description: Fire three arcane bolts half a second apart. Each bolt follows your aim when released and bursts on the first enemy or solid surface.

SANGUINE_DRAIN.title: Sanguine Drain
SANGUINE_DRAIN.description: Damage a visible aimed target and restore 40% of health actually removed, capped at 2 health at level I. Healing scales with spell power.

BLOOD_LANCE.title: Blood Lance
BLOOD_LANCE.description: Drive a straight crimson lance through visible enemies along your aim. Each enemy on the piercing line is hit once; solid cover ends the lance.

EMBER_VEIL.title: Ember Veil
EMBER_VEIL.description: Carry a low ring of embers for three seconds. Three one-second pulses damage visible nearby enemies and ignite them for three seconds.

VENOM_BOLT.title: Venom Bolt
VENOM_BOLT.description: Spit a travelling acid orb with a spore-speckled wake. Its first collision releases a small impact that damages enemies and applies Poison I for four seconds.

MIASMA_FIELD.title: Miasma Field
MIASMA_FIELD.description: Leave a low poisonous cloud at your aim for 4.8 seconds. Five one-second pulses damage visible enemies inside and refresh Poison I for four seconds.

WITHERING_HEX.title: Withering Hex
WITHERING_HEX.description: Hex one visible enemy with direct damage, Poison I for four seconds and Wither I for three seconds.

SOUL_CANNON.title: Soul Cannon
SOUL_CANNON.description: Charge an echo cannon for two seconds, then launch a travelling soul blast. It bursts against the first enemy or solid surface.

SOLAR_CATACLYSM.title: Solar Cataclysm
SOLAR_CATACLYSM.description: Charge for three seconds, mark your aim, then drop a blazing meteor. Ceilings limit its drop. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

TEMPEST_SPEAR.title: Tempest Spear
TEMPEST_SPEAR.description: Charge for 2.5 seconds, then fire a piercing storm lance. Solid cover stops the beam.

EVENT_HORIZON.title: Event Horizon
EVENT_HORIZON.description: Charge for 3.2 seconds, then pull visible enemies inward for 1.5 seconds before a crushing detonation.

DOOM.title: DOOM
DOOM.description: Open an elevated black hole that draws visible enemies inward, then collapses for one heavy area hit. Allies and terrain are protected.

SANCTUARY.title: Sanctuary
SANCTUARY.description: Restore up to 12 health to yourself and eligible allies within eight blocks; cleanse poison, wither, blindness and darkness. Allies include owned pets, scoreboard teammates, and teamless players when enabled.

GLACIAL_RUPTURE.title: Glacial Rupture
GLACIAL_RUPTURE.description: Send a broad glacial front forwards, damaging and chilling each visible enemy once.

EVOKERS_EDICT.title: Evoker's Edict
EVOKERS_EDICT.description: Send three staggered rows of spectral fangs along your aim. Each enemy takes one full hit.

ARCANE_STEP.title: Arcane Step
ARCANE_STEP.description: Blink along your aim to a clear, loaded position. Range grows by 1 block per additional spell level, up to 12 blocks.

BLOOD_NEEDLES.title: Blood Needles
BLOOD_NEEDLES.description: Release five divergent blood needles. Damage is per projectile; projectiles stop at solid cover.

BLOOD_REAP.title: Blood Reap
BLOOD_REAP.description: Sweep a crimson crescent across a 120-degree forward arc. Each visible enemy is hit once.

CRIMSON_TETHER.title: Crimson Tether
CRIMSON_TETHER.description: Tether an aimed enemy for 3 seconds, gently pulling it and dealing three damage pulses. Cover or moving out of range breaks the link.

SANGUINE_PACT.title: Sanguine Pact
SANGUINE_PACT.description: Spend 2 health to gain 4 absorption health and Strength I for 6 seconds at level I. Requires more than 2 current health. Absorption and duration grow with spell power.

CRIMSON_HARVEST.title: Crimson Harvest
CRIMSON_HARVEST.description: Strike an aimed enemy. Deal 50% more direct damage below 35% maximum health; a killing hit restores up to 2 health at level I.

CINDER_STEP.title: Cinder Step
CINDER_STEP.description: Blink through a safe line of sight in a burst of embers. Range grows by 1 block per additional spell level.

PHOENIX_RUSH.title: Phoenix Rush
PHOENIX_RUSH.description: Launch forwards in a rising rush and hit nearby enemies in a four-block launch burst. Slow Falling protects the short descent. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

DRAGON_BREATH.title: Dragon Breath
DRAGON_BREATH.description: Exhale a broad cone of flame following your aim for 1.5 seconds. Three pulses can hit enemies that remain in the cone. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

UMBRAL_STEP.title: Umbral Step
UMBRAL_STEP.description: Blink to a clear position and become invisible for one second. Higher levels extend blink range.

DUSK_CLEAVE.title: Dusk Cleave
DUSK_CLEAVE.description: Carve a shadow crescent across the space in front of you, weakening enemies hit by the arc.

DREAD_EFFIGY.title: Dread Effigy
DREAD_EFFIGY.description: Place a blackstone effigy on visible ground for four seconds. Four pulses damage nearby enemies and refresh Weakness II for 1.5 seconds.

VEIL_OF_NIGHT.title: Veil of Night
VEIL_OF_NIGHT.description: Gain invisibility and Speed I for six seconds at level I. Spell power extends the duration, up to twelve seconds.

NIGHT_BLOOM.title: Night Bloom
NIGHT_BLOOM.description: Place a shadow trap. After a half-second arming period, an enemy within two blocks triggers one area explosion. Untriggered traps expire after four seconds.

STORM_STEP.title: Storm Step
STORM_STEP.description: Surge forwards and upwards with lightning afterimages. Slow Falling protects the short descent.

THUNDERCLAP.title: Thunderclap
THUNDERCLAP.description: Release a broad thunder crescent and knock visible enemies away. Each target is hit once.

ARC_RICOCHET.title: Arc Ricochet
ARC_RICOCHET.description: Throw a travelling lightning orb that can ricochet between three visible enemies, hitting each once.

RIFT_BLINK.title: Rift Blink
RIFT_BLINK.description: Blink along a clear path without crossing solid cover or loading terrain. Higher levels increase its range.

ORBITAL_BLADES.title: Orbital Blades
ORBITAL_BLADES.description: Orbit three spatial blades around yourself for three seconds. Enemies can take one hit per second, up to three hits.

PRISMATIC_RUIN.title: Prismatic Ruin
PRISMATIC_RUIN.description: Merge opposing energies into a slow, broad spatial orb. It passes through enemies, hitting each once, and stops at solid cover or maximum range.

GRAVITY_STAMP.title: Gravity Stamp
GRAVITY_STAMP.description: Mark your aim for one second, then crush visible enemies with a vertical spatial impact.

SPATIAL_SHEAR.title: Spatial Shear
SPATIAL_SHEAR.description: Cut a wide crescent through nearby space, striking each visible enemy in front of you once.

WISP_LANTERN.title: Wisp Lantern
WISP_LANTERN.description: Place a soul lantern on a deepslate post for four seconds. Four echo pulses damage visible enemies near it. Each pulse reveals enemies with a glowing outline for 1.5 seconds. Requires visible solid ground; the boundary ring shows its pulse radius.

RESONANT_GUARD.title: Resonant Guard
RESONANT_GUARD.description: Gain 6 absorption health and Resistance I for five seconds at level I. Spell power improves absorption and duration.

MEMORY_FRACTURE.title: Memory Fracture
MEMORY_FRACTURE.description: Strike an aimed enemy. If it is affected by Darkness, direct damage increases by 50%; combine with Soul Prison.

THORN_LASH.title: Thorn Lash
THORN_LASH.description: Catch an aimed enemy with a thorn tether, pull it towards you and poison it.

VIPER_FANGS.title: Viper Fangs
VIPER_FANGS.description: Release five venom fangs in a spreading fan. Each projectile can poison the enemy it hits.

BRAMBLE_RING.title: Bramble Ring
BRAMBLE_RING.description: Expand a ring of thorns around yourself. Each visible enemy is damaged once, poisoned and briefly slowed.

TOXIC_MOLT.title: Toxic Molt
TOXIC_MOLT.description: Shed poison and wither, restore 4 health at level I and gain Speed I for four seconds. Healing and duration scale with spell power.

SPORE_TOTEM.title: Spore Totem
SPORE_TOTEM.description: Plant a mushroom totem on visible ground for four seconds. Four pulses damage nearby enemies and refresh Poison I for four seconds.

CORROSIVE_RAIN.title: Corrosive Rain
CORROSIVE_RAIN.description: Call an acid cloud at your aim. Five falling pulses damage and poison visible enemies over four seconds.

GORGON_GAZE.title: Gorgon Gaze
GORGON_GAZE.description: Fix visible enemies in a wide forward cone with a petrifying gaze, applying heavy slowness and weakness for two seconds at level I.

LUMINOUS_DART.title: Luminous Dart
LUMINOUS_DART.description: Fire a quick dart of holy light. It stops at solid cover.

MENDING_LIGHT.title: Mending Light
MENDING_LIGHT.description: Restore 6 health at level I to the most injured eligible ally within eight blocks, including yourself. Requires line of sight.

BLESSING_OF_VIGOR.title: Blessing of Vigor
BLESSING_OF_VIGOR.description: Gain 4 absorption health and Speed I for six seconds at level I. Spell power increases the shield and duration.

CONSECRATION.title: Consecration
CONSECRATION.description: Place a radiant altar on visible ground for four seconds. Four pulses damage enemies and heal eligible allies in the marked area.

RADIANT_SWEEP.title: Radiant Sweep
RADIANT_SWEEP.description: Sweep a radiant crescent through visible enemies in front of you.

PILGRIM_STEP.title: Pilgrim Step
PILGRIM_STEP.description: Move along your aim in a flash of light, stopping before obstacles. Higher levels extend the safe blink range.

ABSOLUTION.title: Absolution
ABSOLUTION.description: Cleanse poison, wither, blindness and darkness from eligible allies within eight blocks and grant brief Resistance I.

DAWN_WARD.title: Dawn Ward
DAWN_WARD.description: Deflect hostile incoming projectiles for four seconds at level I. Spell power extends the ward, up to eight seconds.

JUDGEMENT_RAY.title: Judgement Ray
JUDGEMENT_RAY.description: Charge a piercing ray of holy light, striking each visible enemy on its line once. Solid cover stops the ray.

SERAPHIC_DESCENT.title: Seraphic Descent
SERAPHIC_DESCENT.description: Mark your aim for one second, then deliver a pillar of light. It damages enemies and restores 6 health at level I to eligible allies at the impact.

RENEWAL_HYMN.title: Renewal Hymn
RENEWAL_HYMN.description: Carry a healing hymn around yourself for four seconds. Four pulses each restore 2 health at level I to eligible allies with line of sight.

FROST_NEEDLE.title: Frost Needle
FROST_NEEDLE.description: Fire a fast ice needle that chills its target and stops at solid cover.

ICE_SERPENT.title: Ice Serpent
ICE_SERPENT.description: Send a low, weaving ice serpent horizontally along your aim. It chills each enemy struck and stops at solid cover; it does not climb terrain.

RIME_NOVA.title: Rime Nova
RIME_NOVA.description: Expand a frozen ring around yourself, chilling and damaging each visible enemy once.

CRYO_LANCE.title: Cryo Lance
CRYO_LANCE.description: Fire a precise piercing ice lance through visible enemies. Solid cover blocks it.

FROZEN_AEGIS.title: Frozen Aegis
FROZEN_AEGIS.description: Gain 6 absorption health and Resistance I for five seconds at level I. Spell power strengthens and extends the aegis.

GLACIER_STEP.title: Glacier Step
GLACIER_STEP.description: Blink safely in a burst of snowflakes. Higher levels increase the range without allowing travel through walls.

SHATTER.title: Shatter
SHATTER.description: Strike one aimed enemy for 50% more direct damage while it is deeply frozen or affected by Slowness III or stronger. Combine with Glacial Prison or Absolute Zero.

HAILSTORM.title: Hailstorm
HAILSTORM.description: Call a hail cloud at your aim. Five pulses damage and chill visible enemies over four seconds.

GLACIAL_PRISON.title: Glacial Prison
GLACIAL_PRISON.description: Hold an aimed enemy in spectral ice for three seconds at level I. Cover, distance or large movement breaks the restraint.

CRYSTAL_BARRAGE.title: Crystal Barrage
CRYSTAL_BARRAGE.description: Release five divergent crystal projectiles. Damage is per projectile; their impacts chill enemies.

ABSOLUTE_ZERO.title: Absolute Zero
ABSOLUTE_ZERO.description: Establish a frozen domain for four seconds. Four pulses chill and freeze visible enemies in its area.

WARSCREAM.title: Warscream
WARSCREAM.description: Release three ground-shaking roars that damage, pull and taunt nearby enemies. You and eligible allies gain Resistance I for 3–7 seconds, depending on rank.

SOULBLAST.title: Soulblast
SOULBLAST.description: Blast a forward cone of enemies away. Aim sharply downward to launch yourself with brief Slow Falling. While gliding, boost your Elytra along your aim instead.

ARCANE_EDGE.title: Arcane Edge
ARCANE_EDGE.description: Empower yourself with flat melee attack damage and faster attacks for 8–16 seconds. Refreshes the existing enchantment.

BULWARK_CHANT.title: Bulwark Chant
BULWARK_CHANT.description: Grant visible nearby allies Resistance I and temporary health for 8–16 seconds. Shields refresh rather than stack.

BATTLE_TEMPO.title: Battle Tempo
BATTLE_TEMPO.description: A rallying rhythm grants visible nearby allies faster attacks and movement for 8–16 seconds.

CINDER_CLEAVE.title: Cinder Cleave
CINDER_CLEAVE.description: Sweep a burning crescent through a 120-degree cone. Damage includes half your melee attack attribute at release; ignites enemies.

RIME_THRUST.title: Rime Thrust
RIME_THRUST.description: Drive a piercing frost thrust through enemies in a narrow line, stopping at walls. Damage includes half your melee attack attribute; heavily slows for 2 seconds.

BLOOD_REND.title: Blood Rend
BLOOD_REND.description: Rend a 90-degree crescent. Damage includes half your melee attack attribute. Restore 40% of health actually removed, capped at 3–6 health for the entire cast.

KRAKENS_GRASP.title: Kraken’s Grasp
KRAKENS_GRASP.description: The full Kraken rises from beneath the marked ground, curls its tentacles and slams nearby enemies. The slam deals damage and applies three seconds of Slowness. It then sinks away.

ICE_SPIKE_ERUPTION.title: Ice Spike Eruption
ICE_SPIKE_ERUPTION.description: Five ice spikes erupt in a line across a visible ground location. Each enemy can take one hit per cast. Slows and chills enemies without freezing allies.

HELVARS_RIFT.title: Helvar’s Rift
HELVARS_RIFT.description: Launch Helvar’s rift projectile. It stops at the first enemy or solid surface, dealing damage and applying brief Weakness.

KRAKENS_WRATH.title: Kraken’s Wrath
KRAKENS_WRATH.description: Four Kraken tentacles strike around the marked ground before a central, triple-damage slam. Each enemy can take one outer hit and one central hit.

KRAKENS_UNDERTOW.title: Kraken’s Undertow
KRAKENS_UNDERTOW.description: A Kraken tentacle rises at a visible ground location. Its undertow pulls nearby enemies toward the water before one heavy slam. Uses the Kraken’s red model and texture; allies and bosses are not pulled.

YETIS_GLACIAL_WALL.title: Yeti’s Glacial Wall
YETIS_GLACIAL_WALL.description: Raise seven lingering ice spikes in a crescent across visible ground. Each enemy takes at most one hit and is slowed and chilled. Terrain remains intact.

HELVARS_FRACTURE.title: Helvar’s Fracture
HELVARS_FRACTURE.description: Helvar’s rift projectile breaks against the first enemy or wall, releasing an area burst that weakens visible enemies. Terrain remains intact.

HELVARS_SWORDFALL.title: Helvar’s Swordfall
HELVARS_SWORDFALL.description: Summon Helvar’s colossal sword above the mark and drive it into the ground. The blade deals full damage within 3.5 blocks; an expanding nine-block shockwave hits other enemies for 40% damage. Each enemy takes one hit. Requires overhead space.

SANDWORMS_ERUPTION.title: Sandworm’s Eruption
SANDWORMS_ERUPTION.description: The Sandworm’s own sand columns emerge in a row toward the aimed ground. The rising columns strike enemies once per cast; terrain stays intact.

SANDWORMS_QUICKSAND.title: Sandworm’s Quicksand
SANDWORMS_QUICKSAND.description: A spiralling sand vortex slows and draws visible enemies inward. Three sand columns then erupt around its rim for one final strike. Bosses and allies are never pulled; no terrain is changed.

DRAGONS_GUARD.title: Dragon’s Volley
DRAGONS_GUARD.description: Conjure three blazing orbs, then launch them in sequence toward the marked ground. Each orb explodes against the first enemy or solid surface.

DRAGONS_PYRE.title: Dragon’s Cataclysm
DRAGONS_PYRE.description: Mark visible ground with an ember ring. After a one-second warning, a descending fireball releases one heavy shockwave. Requires clear space overhead.

GLACIAL_COUNTER.title: Glacial Counter
GLACIAL_COUNTER.description: Guard for 0.9 seconds against one frontal, blockable hostile hit. The first 0.3 seconds block fully and return a 175% frost counter; later guards reduce damage by 70% and return a normal counter. Environmental damage and bypassing attacks are not blocked.

RIFT_DRAW.title: Rift Draw
RIFT_DRAW.description: Draw a thin distortion along your aim. After a 0.6-second warning, a piercing slash hits visible enemies, adding half your melee attack damage. Walls stop the cut.

CRIMSON_REVERSAL.title: Crimson Reversal
CRIMSON_REVERSAL.description: Blink forward with a blood slash along the clear path, adding half your melee attack damage. Recast within three seconds to return safely to your starting position for no extra mana. The normal cooldown begins when the return is used or expires.

THUNDERBRAND.title: Thunderbrand
THUNDERBRAND.description: Enchant your weapon for ten seconds. Every third successful player melee hit releases chain lightning to that enemy and up to two nearby enemies. Spell damage cannot build charges; recasting refreshes the enchantment without stacking it.

LAST_STAND.title: Last Stand
LAST_STAND.description: Plant a temporary golden banner for six seconds, surrounded by a radiant ward circle. Nearby allies gain Resistance I and one grant of temporary health. The final pulse heals allies still defending the area. Re-entering does not refill the shield.

ASHEN_REBIRTH.title: Ashen Rebirth
ASHEN_REBIRTH.description: Burst forward along a clear path as a phoenix, leaving a burning silhouette. After 0.8 seconds the silhouette detonates. Grants brief Slow Falling; the movement itself deals no damage.

PHANTOM_FORMATION.title: Phantom Formation
PHANTOM_FORMATION.description: Summon four to eight spectral swords for ten seconds. Each successful player melee hit sends one sword toward the struck enemy. Swords have an arming flight, collide with walls and do not trigger further swords or Thunderbrand.

FUNERAL_BELL.title: Funeral Bell
FUNERAL_BELL.description: Charge a funeral bell. Two expanding sonic rings deal the listed damage; a third toll deals triple damage. Each ring strikes an enemy at most once, briefly slowing and pushing it. Walls block the waves.

SPELLBREAKER.title: Spellbreaker
SPELLBREAKER.description: Sweep a close cone, adding half your melee attack damage. Destroy up to 32 hostile or unowned projectiles and interrupt eligible Iron’s casts. Allies, owned projectiles, protected casts and unrelated magic systems are not cancelled.

ASTRAL_APOCALYPSE.title: Astral Apocalypse
ASTRAL_APOCALYPSE.description: Call three groups of falling stars around the mark. Each star damages enemies within four blocks of its impact. A final arcane collapse deals double damage across fourteen blocks.

CRIMSON_ECLIPSE.title: Crimson Eclipse
CRIMSON_ECLIPSE.description: Release three blood tides around the mark, followed by a double-damage final tide. Heal for 8% of health actually removed, up to twenty health across the whole cast.

WORLD_PYRE.title: World Pyre
WORLD_PYRE.description: Call five meteors around the mark. Each erupts in a five-block blast. A final fourteen-block firestorm deals 250% damage and ignites enemies.

VOID_CORONATION.title: Void Coronation
VOID_CORONATION.description: Flood the marked area with shadow and drifting void embers. Three expanding damage pulses suppress enemies with Darkness and Weakness II, followed by a double-damage collapse.

HEAVENS_THUNDER.title: Heaven’s Thunder
HEAVENS_THUNDER.description: Call six lightning columns around the mark, each striking a six-block area. A final fourteen-block thunderclap deals double damage. Columns can overlap.

RIFT_COLLISION.title: Rift Collision
RIFT_COLLISION.description: Pull visible enemies inward, then cut the area along two perpendicular lines. A final fourteen-block spatial implosion deals triple damage.

SOUL_REQUIEM.title: Soul Requiem
SOUL_REQUIEM.description: Unleash three soul pulses at four, eight and twelve blocks from the mark. Enemies touched by a pulse are revealed and afflicted with Darkness. A final blast deals double damage across the area.

WORLDROOT_CATASTROPHE.title: Worldroot Blessing
WORLDROOT_CATASTROPHE.description: Overgrow the mark with moss, flowering leaves and spores. Three pulses damage, poison and slow enemies. A final bloom deals double damage and heals eligible allies.

FINAL_JUDGEMENT.title: Final Judgement
FINAL_JUDGEMENT.description: Summon a golden sword over the mark. Three holy pulses damage enemies and heal allies; the final verdict deals double damage, heals, cleanses afflictions and grants Resistance I for five seconds.

ETERNAL_WINTER.title: Eternal Winter
ETERNAL_WINTER.description: Unleash a ten-second blizzard over the marked area. Eight pulses damage and freeze enemies with Slowness IV. A final burst deals triple damage. Terrain remains intact.

EXPLOSION.title: Explosion
EXPLOSION.description: Lock your aim and channel five golden seals into a towering ignition beam. Release one immense explosion; the rising fireball and shockwave deal no extra hits. Brief Slowness and Weakness follow the blast.

SERAPH_ASCENDANT.title: Seraph Ascendant
SERAPH_ASCENDANT.description: Gain flight for twenty seconds; double-jump to fly. Nearby eligible allies gain 15% spell power and receive healing once per second. Slow Falling protects you when the blessing ends.

ARCANE_DEVASTATOR.title: Arcane Devastator
ARCANE_DEVASTATOR.description: Channel cosmic energy, then release a sustained beam along your final aim. Each enemy entering its path takes one hit. New cover stops the beam.

I_AM_ATOMIC.title: I Am Atomic
I_AM_ATOMIC.description: Anchor a violet containment sphere and compress mana at a spectral sword. Hold enemies inside, shelter allies and absorb hostile projectiles crossing the boundary. Release one devastating detonation. Moving more than three blocks interrupts the ritual; bosses resist containment.

DOOM_BEAM.title: Doom Beam
DOOM_BEAM.description: Compress a black singularity that turns emerald halfway through the charge. Release a green plasma beam that follows your movement and aim. Each enemy entering its path takes one hit; solid cover stops it.

VOID_EXILE.title: Void Exile
VOID_EXILE.description: Banish one hostile living target for ten seconds, leaving a violet rift. On return, it takes damage before receiving Weakness II for five seconds. Bosses, mounted, leashed and dimension-immune targets resist.

VOID_DOMAIN.title: Void Domain
VOID_DOMAIN.description: Raise a vast black sphere at your casting location for fifteen seconds. Enemies inside suffer Slowness III, Weakness II and Darkness. You and eligible allies gain Resistance II, Regeneration II, Speed II and 25% spell power. Effects fade shortly after leaving; walls block their influence.

POLARITY_BOLT.title: Polarity Bolt
POLARITY_BOLT.description: Fire a scarlet-and-azure magnetic bolt. Its first enemy impact deals damage and pulls the target toward you; solid cover stops it.

EMP_SURGE.title: EMP Surge
EMP_SURGE.description: Release an electromagnetic pulse around yourself. Damage enemies, stun non-bosses for three seconds, interrupt eligible spellcasts and destroy hostile projectiles.

MAGNETAR_ANNIHILATION.title: Magnetar Annihilation
MAGNETAR_ANNIHILATION.description: Compress opposing magnetic poles, then unleash a blue-white annihilation beam following your aim for seven seconds. Each enemy entering it takes one heavy hit. Solid cover stops the beam.

AMBER_TALON.title: Amber Talon
AMBER_TALON.description: Conjure a spectral Subterranodon that dives along your aim. Its first collision slashes one enemy and briefly lifts it; the spirit fades after the strike.

TECTONIC_STAMPEDE.title: Primordial Instinct
TECTONIC_STAMPEDE.description: Awaken your allies’ dinosaur instincts for twenty seconds. Primal Instinct grants +25% melee damage, +20% attack speed and +15% movement speed, with Resistance I. The blessing does not stack with itself.

LUX_EXTINCTION.title: Lux’s Caldera
LUX_EXTINCTION.description: Condense a molten tephra sun over the mark. Four rounds of volcanic vents telegraph beneath up to six enemies; each erupts after 0.4 seconds and can be dodged. The core then falls in a double-damage extinction blast. Allies and terrain are protected.

ACID_GLOB.title: Acid Glob
ACID_GLOB.description: Lob a glowing acid glob along your aim. It splashes on the first enemy or solid surface, damaging enemies in a small area and poisoning them for three seconds.

TREMORZILLA_BREATH.title: Tremorzilla Breath
TREMORZILLA_BREATH.description: Channel Tremorzilla’s native atomic breath from your body for five seconds. Each enemy takes one hit. Hold Amber Curiosity offhand for purple retro breath, or a Tectonic Shard for orange; otherwise it is green. Cover stops the beam.

NUCLEAR_STRIKE.title: Nuclear Strike
NUCLEAR_STRIKE.description: Mark a nuclear strike. A descending warhead detonates after a visible warning, releasing one immense blast and Alex’s Caves mushroom cloud. Enemies are weakened by the fallout; allies and terrain remain protected.

BRINE_BUBBLE.title: Brine Bubble
BRINE_BUBBLE.description: Launch a Deep One water bolt. Its first enemy impact deals damage and traps non-boss targets in Alex’s Caves bubble effect for two seconds.

HULLBREAKER_SURGE.title: Hullbreaker’s Breach
HULLBREAKER_SURGE.description: Mark a breach in the ground. After a 1.2-second warning, a Hullbreaker rises from below, bites enemies in the marked circle and launches them upward before diving away. Solid cover and ally protection apply.

ABYSSAL_DELUGE.title: Abyssal Deluge
ABYSSAL_DELUGE.description: Open a deep-sea vortex at the mark. Four tidal pulses drag enemies inward before a double-damage pressure collapse. Deep One magic and towering splashes trace the battlefield.

DESOLATE_DAGGER.title: Desolate Dagger
DESOLATE_DAGGER.description: Send a spectral Desolate Dagger along your aim. It pierces up to three enemies, dealing one hit and Weakness I to each before fading. Solid cover stops the blade.

FORSAKEN_SONAR.title: Forsaken Sonar
FORSAKEN_SONAR.description: Manifest the Forsaken’s jaws and release three aimed sonar waves. Each wave damages visible enemies in a broad forward cone, reveals them and briefly slows them.

FORLORN_RECKONING.title: Forlorn Reckoning
FORLORN_RECKONING.description: Call forth a colossal Forsaken apparition. Three growing sonar shockwaves damage, reveal and darken enemies before a double-damage final roar.

GUMBALL_VOLLEY.title: Gumball Volley
GUMBALL_VOLLEY.description: Fire three native gumballs half a second apart. Each projectile bounces off one solid surface and damages the first enemy it reaches.

FROSTMINT_HEX.title: Frostmint Hex
FROSTMINT_HEX.description: Place a sugar-staff hex surrounded by orbiting frostmint discs. Five pulses damage and freeze enemies inside; eligible allies gain Sugar Rush while holding the circle.

CANDY_CATASTROPHE.title: Candyland Catastrophe
CANDY_CATASTROPHE.description: Raise a candy-witch vortex over the mark. Four peppermint storms batter enemies while a Gum Worm emerges below, then a double-damage candy burst ends the spell. Allies and terrain are protected.

THUNDER_OF_THE_HEAVENS.title: Thunder of the Heavens
THUNDER_OF_THE_HEAVENS.description: Mark a vast storm field, then unleash 200 violet lightning strikes over ten seconds. One strike per volley tracks a visible enemy; the others scour the marked ground. Each strike damages only nearby enemies. Allies and terrain are protected.

ARCANE_CREATION.title: Arcane Creation
ARCANE_CREATION.description: Weave six rotating astral stars around the mark. Each star collapses in sequence, blasting a different sector, before the entire constellation converges into a double-damage central verdict.

CRIMSON_APOTHEOSIS.title: Crimson Apotheosis
CRIMSON_APOTHEOSIS.description: Claim the marked battlefield with five blood tithes. Scarlet tethers drain visible enemies every second and restore up to twenty health to you across the cast. A final blood nova deals double damage. Allies are protected.

SOLAR_SUPERNOVA.title: Solar Supernova
SOLAR_SUPERNOVA.description: Condense a blazing sun above the mark. After two seconds of violent compression, a single expanding supernova burns every visible enemy caught by its advancing front. The warning gives enemies time to escape; terrain is protected.

EVENTIDE_HORIZON.title: Eventide Horizon
EVENTIDE_HORIZON.description: Open four crossing void seams through the mark. Successive rift cuts suppress enemies on those lines, then a final dimensional fold strikes the entire field for double damage. Each cut respects solid cover.

ABSOLUTE_GLACIATION.title: Absolute Glaciation
ABSOLUTE_GLACIATION.description: Send an expanding glacier front across the field, freezing enemies as it reaches them. Four cold pulses follow, then a double-damage ice shatter. The advancing front and final shatter each hit an enemy once.

VERDANT_AWAKENING.title: Verdant Awakening
VERDANT_AWAKENING.description: Awaken a vast flowering grove. Six root pulses drag and poison enemies while healing nearby allies and refreshing their Resistance I. A final seedburst deals triple damage. Moss, azalea and luminous spores fill the grove.

HEAVENS_COVENANT.title: Heaven’s Covenant
HEAVENS_COVENANT.description: Establish a radiant covenant. Five holy verdicts damage enemies and cleanse and heal eligible allies. Allies inside gain Resistance II and +35% spell power; leaving the field stops the refresh. A final double-damage verdict closes the covenant.

SOUL_ASCENDANCY.title: Soul Ascendancy
SOUL_ASCENDANCY.description: Raise five spiralling soul harvests over the mark. Each harvest reaps visible enemies and grants you a non-stacking absorption ward. The last procession closes in a double-damage soul burst. Walls and allies are protected.

PLANETARY_POLARITY.title: Planetary Polarity
PLANETARY_POLARITY.description: Establish two opposing magnetic poles that orbit the field. Six alternating polarity pulses pull and repel enemies, clearing hostile projectiles at ignition, before the poles collide in a double-damage annihilation.

PRIMORDIAL_SOVEREIGN.title: Primordial Sovereign
PRIMORDIAL_SOVEREIGN.description: Lead a primeval hunt. Dinosaur spirits guard the marked field; five ground charges damage enemies while eligible allies receive Primal Instinct, Resistance II and regeneration. The final charge deals double damage.

TREMORZILLA_CATACLYSM.title: Tremorzilla Cataclysm
TREMORZILLA_CATACLYSM.description: Channel a colossal purple retro Tremorzilla beam from your body for ten seconds. It follows your current aim, strikes each enemy once and erupts continuously at the impact point. Solid cover stops the beam; allies and terrain are protected.

ABYSSAL_WORLD_TIDE.title: Abyssal World Tide
ABYSSAL_WORLD_TIDE.description: Call four deep-sea pressure walls inward from the field’s edge. Six tidal collapses damage and drag enemies toward the mark; the last traps non-bosses in bubbles. Allies receive water breathing and Resistance II inside the tide.

FORSAKEN_ECLIPSE.title: Forsaken Eclipse
FORSAKEN_ECLIPSE.description: Surround the mark with four Forsaken apparitions. Their aimed sonar crosses the battlefield in three tightening waves, revealing and darkening enemies. The final converging roar deals triple damage.

CONFECTION_APOCALYPSE.title: Confection Apocalypse
CONFECTION_APOCALYPSE.description: Raise a colossal sugar hex. Giant gumballs rain into six marked sectors as peppermint discs sweep the field; each sector bursts once, followed by a triple-damage candy finale. Eligible allies inside receive Sugar Rush.

KRAKEN_WORLD_DROWN.title: Kraken’s World Drown
KRAKEN_WORLD_DROWN.description: Call a ring of eight native Kraken tentacles around the mark. Paired slams collapse the ring inward and drag visible enemies into a final triple-damage tidal crush. Terrain and allies are protected.

YETI_WORLD_HEART.title: Yeti’s World Heart
YETI_WORLD_HEART.description: Raise three expanding rings of native Yeti ice spikes. Each front hits visible enemies once and freezes their advance; a final triple-damage glacial rupture shatters the marked field.

HELVAR_FINAL_EDICT.title: Helvar’s Final Edict
HELVAR_FINAL_EDICT.description: Manifest Helvar’s colossal sword over the mark. Three ember-red fracture waves cut outward before the blade strikes in a triple-damage judgement and expanding ground shockwave. Allies and terrain are protected.

SANDWORM_WORLD_DEVOURER.title: Sandworm’s World Devourer
SANDWORM_WORLD_DEVOURER.description: Open four sandworm eruption lanes around the mark. Five travelling sand fronts drag and batter enemies, then a triple-damage upheaval ends the devouring field. Bosses resist forced movement.

DRAGON_PRIMORDIAL_INFERNO.title: Dragon’s Primordial Inferno
DRAGON_PRIMORDIAL_INFERNO.description: Command six descending native dragon flame comets. Each falls into a different sector and leaves a lingering fire pool while enemies reposition. A final triple-damage inferno consumes the marked field. Allies and terrain are protected.

ORBITAL_RAY.title: Orbital Ray
ORBITAL_RAY.description: Gather swirling violet and golden magic into a growing orb for 15 seconds. Launch it skyward over a locked target, then fire a vertical arcane beam and a nuclear-style explosion. Each enemy takes one hit; allies and terrain are protected. Requires visible ground and at least 12 blocks of clear sky above the mark.
